description: This JavaScript source file defines functions for querying and aggregating LLM cost data by agent. It includes MongoDB aggregation pipeline builders, a fallback in-process aggregator, and an exported asynchronous function to retrieve agent cost summaries. The code is focused on processing cost data for analytics purposes within a backend service.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for flat schema documents, filtering for documents with agent identifiers and total cost fields, and preparing data for aggregation.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB pipeline to process embedded Agents array schemas, extracting agent names and costs, and preparing data for aggregation.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Performs in-memory aggregation over an array of documents with Agents array, summing costs per agent with 6-decimal precision, used as fallback if database aggregation fails.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main exported async function that attempts to retrieve and aggregate LLM cost data from various collections and schemas via database pipelines, falling back to in-memory aggregation if needed, and returning a sorted list of agent costs.
